# Local + CI builds use the patched vendored dart_tui fork (keyboard
# protocol fixes); the published package depends on hosted dart_tui —
# this file never ships to pub.dev.
dependency_overrides:
  dart_tui:
    path: vendor/dart_tui
  # gh-2208: patched fork exposing `pid` so the PTY test harness can
  # SIGKILL-escalate children that survive the cooperative kill() — a
  # leaked child wedges the Dart VM's exit handshake and zombies the CI
  # leg (vendor/pty2/VENDORED.md, tracker #2122).
  pty2:
    path: vendor/pty2
=====
  # pointycastle (package:cryptography's RSA is UnimplementedError on the
  # VM — issue #1377 review r7). Floor ^3.9.1 per the review; capped <5
  # and open to 4.x because flutter_app (`fa`, path-depends on this
  # package) resolves together with dartssh2, which requires pointycastle
  # ^4.0.0 — a ^3.9.1-only constraint here breaks fa's resolution.
  pointycastle: ">=3.9.1 <5.0.0"
  sqlite3: ^3.5.1
  yaml: ^3.1.3

dev_dependencies:
  coverage: ^1.15.1
  # Scripted mock LLM server for integration tests (issue #45).
  fa_llm_mock:
    path: packages/fa_llm_mock
  lints: ^6.1.0
  # scripts/ (verify_builtin_skills, gen_prompts) and test/ resolve skill
  # dir names via p.basename — declare the transitive dep directly.
  path: ^1.9.0
  pty2: ^0.5.3
  test: ^1.31.2
  xterm:
    path: vendor/xterm

# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

# gh-1522: stamp the staged tree from the release tag (pubspec version +
# generated changelog section). Runs AFTER the size guard, BEFORE the
# caller's `dart pub get` + `dart pub publish` — the stamp is part of the
# staged artifact, never of the repo.
if [ "${2:-}" ]; then
  bash "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/stamp_staged_release.sh" "$target" "$2"
fi

content.text:
# Vendored: pty2

- **Upstream**: https://github.com/jtmcdole/termui/tree/main/packages/pty2
  (pub.dev `pty2 0.5.7`, MIT — see LICENSE).
- **Why vendored**: gh-2208 — pty2's `BlockingPseudoTerminal` runs a
  `_waitForExitCode` isolate blocked in a native FFI `waitpid` with no
  timeout. While a PTY child lives, that isolate can neither reach a
  safepoint nor answer the Dart VM's exit-time check-in handshake, so the
  whole `dart test` process wedges forever
  (`Attempt:N waiting for isolate _waitForExitCode to check in` — CI runs
  43835937617 / v1.0.735 and 43151400571 / PR #2121; tracker issue #2122).
  The PTY test harness (`test/integration/pty_harness.dart`) needs the
  child pid to SIGKILL-escalate when the cooperative `kill()` (SIGTERM +
  SIGHUP, once-only per pty2's `_killed` flag) does not reap the child
  within its grace window — otherwise a leaked child turns the CI leg
  into a 40-minute zombie.
- **Patch vs upstream 0.5.7** (the only diff): the `pid` getter is exposed
  end-to-end — `PtyCore.pid` + `PseudoTerminal.pid` interface members,
  `BasePseudoTerminal.pid`/`PtyCoreUnix.pid` delegating to the existing
  private `_pid`, and `PtyCoreWindows.pid` via `GetProcessId(_hProcess)`
  (upstream's commented-out shape returned the process HANDLE, not the
  pid). `pubspec.yaml`: dropped the upstream `resolution: workspace`
  marker (this repo is not a pub workspace). Everything else is verbatim.
- **Consumers**: the root package only (`pubspec_overrides.yaml`);
  `flutter_app` keeps the hosted 0.5.7 — behavior identical, the patch
  adds getters only.
- **Un-vendor when**: upstream exposes `pid` in a release; bump the
  override back to the hosted constraint and delete this directory.

content.text:
# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. This file is
the agent ENTRY document: the harness merges it into the system prompt with
a ~19 KB entry budget, so it must stay small enough to be fully visible.
Ceiling: **≤ 300 lines / ≤ 20 KB** — enforced by
`scripts/check_agents_md_size.sh` (pre-commit hook via `ci_fast_gate.sh` +
the CI `static` job). Subsystem essays live in `docs/` — index:
`docs/README.md`. Keep entries factual: paths, commands, invariants.

## Module map

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph CORE["SDK - flutter_agent_harness, pure Dart (lib/)"]
        AI["ai: providers, agent loop, sessions, compaction"]
        TOLS["tools: approval, redact, hashline, memory"]
        HOSTS["hosts: shared wiring, messaging, a2a, hub"]
    end
    subgraph PKG["packages/ - sibling Dart packages"]
        FAUI["fa_ui: widgets incl. trajectory"]
        DAP["dap_hub, fa_llm, fa_llm_mock"]
    end
    CLI["fa CLI - bin/ + lib/src/cli: TUI, slash commands, headless"]
    APP["Flutter app - flutter_app/: desktop, mobile, web shells"]
    EXT["Browser extension - browser_ext/ + lib/src/browser + serve_bridge"]
    OFFICE["Office add-in - office_addin/ + FA_HOST=office host"]
    GOLDEN["UI golden & styles - golden tests, themes, ui tests"]
    NETW["fa_network - external Go backend + network clients"]
    CORE --> CLI
    CORE --> APP
    CORE --> EXT
    PKG --> APP
    PKG --> CLI
    APP --> OFFICE
    CLI --> NETW
    APP --> NETW
    EXT --> NETW
    GOLDEN --> APP
    GOLDEN --> FAUI
```

## Project layout — one line per subsystem

Full subsystem reference: `docs/agents/sdk-subsystems.md` (SDK) +
`docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md` (app/packages/repo-level).

**SDK core (`lib/`, pure Dart):**

- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers, session modes, per-tool overrides, critical-bash interceptor, per-turn grants.
- `lib/src/tools/` — `ask`/`request_secret`/media tools, `read` selectors + archives + sqlite, background shell jobs, availability + load modes.
- `lib/src/env/` — `ExecutionEnv` impls: `LocalShell` (setsid, killTree, drain caps, self-signal immunity), session-correlation vars, in-memory default.
- `lib/src/agent/` — FinalizeGate, tool pairing, session image registry.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — trajectory ledger core; goldens under `test/trajectory/goldens/`.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (prompt, tool args, output, logs).
- `lib/src/hashline/` — `[path#TAG]` patch language (SWAP/DEL/INS, stale-tag rejection).
- `lib/src/compaction/` — branch summarization + AutoCompactor → policy: `docs/compaction.md`.
- `lib/src/lsp/`, `lib/src/mcp/` — `lsp` + MCP protocol tooling (lazy servers, pure-Dart transports).
- `lib/src/model_roles/` — roles/fallbacks/keyring/watchdogs + provider catalog; `lib/src/ttsr/` — streaming-interrupt rules.
- `lib/src/skills/`, `lib/src/prompts/` — skills discovery; AGENTS/CLAUDE/GOAL/DESIGN auto-merge into the system prompt.
- `lib/src/task/`, `lib/src/messaging/`, `lib/src/session/attach/` — subagents, inbox fabric, attached sessions → `docs/subagents/README.md`.
- `lib/src/memory/` — long-term memory (hosted `flutter_agent_memory` package) → pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`.
- `lib/src/a2a/` — Agent2Agent client/server/manager (`fa serve --a2a`).
- `bin/fah.dart` + `lib/src/cli/` — the `fa` CLI: REPL, slash commands, headless/serve modes → `docs/agents/cli.md`.
- `lib/src/cube/` — fa_cube sandbox profiles → `docs/cubes.md`; `lib/src/cli/hep.dart` — HEP event protocol → `docs/hep.md`.
- `lib/src/web_search/` — `web_search` (DDG keyless → keyed providers); `tool/fa-clip/` — native macOS pasteboard helper.

**packages/ + app shells:**

- `packages/fa_ui/` — reusable widgets (incl. trajectory) → `docs/agents/fa-ui.md`; `dap_hub`, `fa_llm`, `fa_llm_mock` → `docs/dap.md`.
- `flutter_app/` — the Flutter app (desktop/mobile/web) → `docs/agents/flutter-app.md`; services one-liner: `docs/agents/services.md`; JS apps: `docs/agents/js-apps.md`; HomeKit/Calendar/CodeMie: `docs/agents/system-integrations.md`.
- `browser_ext/` + `lib/src/browser/` + `bin/serve_bridge.dart` — browser extension + WebSocket bridge → `docs/browser-extension.md`.
- `office_addin/` + FA_HOST=office app host — Office add-in → `docs/outlook-addin.md`.
- `fa_network` — external Go backend bridged via the DAP hub (channel-id caveats: `docs/dap.md` §14).
- `site/`, `scripts/`, `docs/subagents/` — landing page (privacy sync), gates + codegen, subagents master plan → `docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md`.

set -euo pipefail

cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"

echo "🎨 Auto-formatting staged Dart files..."
# Format is SELF-HEALING with a BLOCKING backstop: reformat exactly the
# Dart files in the index and re-stage them; anything still unformatted
# after that (formatter crashed on syntax errors) blocks the commit with a
# clear message. A whole-tree `--set-exit-if-changed` gate both (a) failed
# commits over a single unformatted line and (b) rewrote OTHER agents'
# work-in-progress files mid-edit when run concurrently — scoped auto-fix
# avoids both.
STAGED_DART=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep '\.dart$' || true)
if [ -n "$STAGED_DART" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs dart format >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  printf '%s\n' "$STAGED_DART" | xargs git add --
  UNFORMATTED=$(dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed $STAGED_DART 2>/dev/null | grep '^Changed' || true)
  if [ -n "$UNFORMATTED" ]; then
    echo "❌ dart format could not fix these files (syntax error?):"
    echo "$UNFORMATTED"
    exit 1
  fi
fi
